// Only solid neighboring shelving can be used as a mounting surface.
// A player near the edge of two neighboring shelf tiles can still mount it:
// the preferred neighbor is deterministic (up, right, down, left).
function stripeMountDirection(x,y){
const sides=[['up',0,-1],['right',1,0],['down',0,1],['left',-1,0]];
const found=sides.filter(([dir,dx,dy])=>isShelfTile(x+dx,y+dy));

}
function drawMambaStripe(x,y,mount='up',stage=0,alpha=1){
const direction=MAMBA_SOURCE_ANCHOR[`${mount}_0`]?mount:'up';
const frame=mambaStripeFrames[`${direction}_${Math.max(0,Math.min(3,Math.floor(stage)))}`];
if(!frame||!frame.complete||!frame.naturalWidth)return;
const box=MAMBA_SOURCE_ANCHOR[`${direction}_0`];
if(!box)return;
const [left,top,right,bottom]=box;
// A fully installed strip stays within ONE 42×42 gameplay tile.
// The same scale is used for the falling packs, which can overhang slightly.
const scale=(TILE-6)/(bottom-top);
const midX=(left+right)/2,midY=(top+bottom)/2;
let anchorX=x*TILE+TILE/2,anchorY=y*TILE+TILE/2;
let originX=anchorX-midX*scale,originY=anchorY-midY*scale;
if(direction==='up')originY=y*TILE+2-top*scale;
if(direction==='down')originY=(y+1)*TILE-2-bottom*scale;
if(direction==='left')originX=x*TILE+2-left*scale;
if(direction==='right')originX=(x+1)*TILE-2-right*scale;
ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha*=alpha;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
ctx.drawImage(frame,originX,originY,frame.naturalWidth*scale,frame.naturalHeight*scale);

}

function playableCameraWidth(){

if(!hud || getComputedStyle(hud).display==='none')return viewW;
const gameRect=viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
const hudRect=hud.getBoundingClientRect();

// fullscreen and when the responsive panel changes width.
const hudLeft=hudRect.left-gameRect.left;

const SETTINGS=[['playerSpeed','Скорость героя',1.5,5,.1],['enemyFactor','Скорость мерча ×',.2,1.3,.05],['buyerFactor','Скорость покупателей ×',.3,1.8,.05],['standTime','Монтаж стойки, с',.3,5,.1],['theaterTime','Монтаж театро, с',.5,7,.1],['standRemove','Демонтаж стойки, с',1,12,.5],['theaterRemove','Демонтаж театро, с',2,20,.5],['stripeAlertRadius','Радиус реакции на страйп, клетки',2,7,.5],['respawnMin','Мин. респавн врага, с',3,15,.5],['respawnMax','Макс. респавн врага, с',4,20,.5],['buyerPeriod','Покупатели каждые, с',3,25,.5],['resupplyPeriod','Резервная поставка, с',8,60,1],['checkoutWait','Оплата на кассе, с',1,8,.2],['reward','Награда за стойку, ₽',25,300,5],['theaterReward','Награда за театрализацию, ₽',25,350,5],['saleWait','Выбор у стойки, с',1,2,.1],['theaterSaleWait','Выбор у театрализации, с',1,2,.1],['standPrice','Цена стойки, ₽',10,250,5],['stripePrice','Цена ленты, ₽',10,250,5],['theaterPrice','Цена театро, ₽',25,350,5]];
for(const [id,label,min,max,step] of SETTINGS){let outer=document.createElement('label'),name=document.createElement('span'),input=document.createElement('input');name.textContent=label;input.type='number';input.min=min;input.max=max;input.step=step;input.value=balance[id];input.addEventListener('change',()=>{const value=Number(input.value);balance[id]=clamp(Number.isFinite(value)?value:DEFAULT[id],min,max);input.value=balance[id];try{localStorage.setItem(SETKEY,JSON.stringify(balance))}catch{}updateUI()});outer.append(name,input);$('settings').appendChild(outer)}
window.addEventListener('resize',resizeCanvas);window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('resize',resizeCanvas);window.addEventListener('orientationchange',()=>setTimeout(resizeCanvas,150));window.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&running&&!paused)togglePause()});

// v0.5.6au: reuse the exact existing game assets in the HUD selection cards.
(function(){
const visualMap = [
['hudImgStand',TOFFIFEE_STAND_ASSETS[5]],
['hudImgTheater',MERCI_THEATER_ASSETS[3]],
['hudImgStripe',MAMBA_STRIPE_DATA.up_0],
['hudImgPermanent',TOFFIFEE_STAND_ASSETS[5]]

}
